region: Nairobi (overlooking Nairobi National Park, southern river border)

2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/Ololo Lodge/2026 20% Nett Rates - Ololo Safari Lodge & Farm (1).pdf
notes: The '20% Nett Rates' document's cover page has a typo in its date range ('January 1st 2026 - December 31st 2025') - the actual rate table on page 2 correctly states '1st Jan 2026 - 31st Dec 2026'. Flagged, not treated as a real validity issue.

NETT discount confirmed approximately as Rack x 0.80 across all categories (e.g. Old Stable Rooms adult: 305/380=0.80; Family Wing adult: 390/490=0.796; Tower Room adult: 470/590=0.796) - a Nett/STO ~20% tier, and unusually still commissionable to agents at 10% on top (stated explicitly in the Nett document).

Room categories are grouped in pairs sharing one price point: (7 Old Stable Rooms + 3 Tented Cottages) share one rate; (Family Wing + 3-bedroom Stable Cottage) share another; (Tower Room + Terrace Room) share the third.
This is a flexible Nairobi/stopover hotel candidate not yet in CLAUDE.md's known priced list - notable for combining a Nairobi stay with Nairobi National Park game drives.

oldStableRoomsAndTentedCottages.description: 7x Old Stable Rooms (5 Queen Double + 2 Twin, small terraces); 3x Tented Cottages (King Double + terraces)

familyWingAndStableCottage.description: Family Wing (min 4, sleeps 5: 1 mezzanine King Double + 1 triple single bedroom, 2 bathrooms, kitchenette, living room, terrace); 3-bedroom Stable Cottage (min 4, sleeps 6: 2 King Double + 1 Twin, 2 bathrooms, kitchenette, living room, terrace)

towerRoomAndTerraceRoom.description: Tower Room (King Double/Twin + balcony + private rooftop terrace); Terrace Room (King Double + private terrace)

commission: 10% (Nett rate document explicitly states commissionable to agents at 10%)
includes: Airport transfers (JKIA, Wilson Airport, nearby hotels)
Soft drinks, house wine, beer, selected spirits, barista coffee
WiFi, swimming pool, bush sauna, laundry, VAT
2 daily shared game drives in Nairobi National Park
Guided Ololo farm tours/activities, guided walk to Kitengela Hot Glass
Excursion to David Sheldrick's Wildlife Trust (entry fees excluded, pre-booking required)
Kids activities (Farm Kids Program, painting, games)
excludes: KWS Nairobi National Park fees (purchased on guest's behalf, added to reservation)
Exclusive use of vehicle for game drives ($250)

childPolicy.raw: Infants 0-3: free. Children in own room charged adult sharing rate.

dayRoom.raw: 75% of nightly rate, includes an extra game drive, meals and drinks until departure, airport transfers

lateDeparture.raw: After 5pm: US$120/adult, US$75/child (includes lunch, dinner, drinks, lodge use). Room checkout remains 10am unless a day room is booked.

parkFeesNote: Nairobi National Park fees valid 24hrs from time of entry; additional fees charged if staying longer than 24hrs.

policies.balancePayment: Due 45 days prior to arrival, or lodge may release rooms
policies.lastMinuteDirectBookings: Non-resident bookings made direct to lodge must be paid in full 1 day prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: 120-45 days: 25% of total cost (the deposit); 45-30 days: 50% forfeited; <30 days/no-show: 100% forfeited. >120 days with genuine serious reason: postponement up to 1 year may be offered instead.
policies.tourOperatorExcursions: Tour operators conducting their own independent excursions must pick up/return guests through Ololo - Ololo does not transport guests to/from NNP Main Gate except at its own fee.
policies.sheldrickTrustExcursion: Entry fees payable by guests for 11am sessions, must be pre-booked; Ololo offers complimentary return transfers.
